scenarios.criterion: Given an order waiting at a run gate (waiting), waiting for its commit to be approved (completed), or waiting for its pull request to be approved (proposed), closing it with `loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>` records it shipped exactly as a parked order today: one shipped ledger entry with the URL and approvedBy, then the run archived and the worktree removed.
scenarios.name: Closing an order waiting at a run gate records it shipped and archives its run
given: An order is waiting at a run gate
when: An operator closes the order with loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>
then: Exactly one shipped ledger entry is recorded carrying the URL and the approver
The order's run is archived
The order's worktree is removed

scenarios.criterion: After closing a waiting, completed, or proposed order, `loom factory inbox` no longer lists it, nothing is committed or pushed for it, and no pull request is opened for it — even if an approval for it was already in the ledger and not yet acted on.
scenarios.name: Closing a waiting, completed, or proposed order removes it from the inbox and takes no further action, even with a stale unacted-on approval
given: An order is waiting, waiting for commit approval, or waiting for pull request approval
The order may already carry an approval in the ledger that has not yet been acted on
when: The order is closed with loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>
then: loom factory inbox no longer lists the order
Nothing is committed or pushed for the order
No pull request is opened for the order

scenarios.criterion: An order whose run process is alive (running), one between a commit and its pull request (committed, pushed), or one scheduled to retry (retrying) still refuses close with exit code 1 and the phase named; the ledger does not change. An already-shipped order is refused as today.
scenarios.name: Closing an order whose run is still active, mid-flight, or scheduled to retry is refused
given: An order's run process is alive, or the order is between a commit and its pull request, or the order is scheduled to retry
when: An operator attempts to close the order with loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>
then: The close command exits with code 1
The refusal message names the order's current phase
The ledger does not change

scenarios.criterion: An order whose run process is alive (running), one between a commit and its pull request (committed, pushed), or one scheduled to retry (retrying) still refuses close with exit code 1 and the phase named; the ledger does not change. An already-shipped order is refused as today.
scenarios.name: Closing an already-shipped order is refused
when: An operator attempts to close the order with loom factory close <order> --shipped-by <url>
then: The close command exits with code 1
The refusal message states the order has already shipped
The ledger does not change

scenarios.criterion: With the supervisor ticking, closing a waiting order and then running one more supervisor tick never relaunches, commits, or proposes that order again.
scenarios.name: A supervisor tick after closing a waiting order takes no further action on it
given: An order was waiting and has been closed with --shipped-by
The supervisor is running its regular tick loop
when: The supervisor runs one more tick
then: The order is not relaunched
No commit is made for the order
No pull request is opened for the order
No new ledger entry is appended for the order

scenarios.criterion: templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md's close section names every phase close now accepts (parked, stopped, waiting, completed, proposed).

given: The intake README at templates/claude-feature-team/intake/README.md documents loom factory close
when: A reader reviews the close section's list of acceptable phases
then: The list names parked, stopped, waiting, completed, and proposed
